collection.description: A child wakes from a strange dream and asks what it meant.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) wakes from a strange dream and asks what it meant.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a healer, says dreams can mix memories and imagination.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that a frightening dream need not predict anything.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) shares one interpretation while acknowledging uncertainty.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) hears that other families understand dreams differently.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) turns the dream into a colorful picture.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) decides the dream is private and keeps the drawing.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) feels safer after talking about the dream.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) prefers to rest without discussing details.
